title: Quantitative Assessment of Protein-DNA Interactions via SYBR Green Fluorescence
authors: Jingxin Wang; Jingwen Wang; Zhibo Wang; Pengyu Wang; Shilin Sun; Xiaofu Li; Zhen Tian; Ruibing Xu; Yifan Shi; Yucheng Wang
one_liner_zh: 该文开发基于qPCR的蛋白质-DNA互作定量检测方法，属湿实验技术，无AI或物理模拟建模，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Protein-DNA interactions are crucial for cellular processes, but current quantification methods lack sensitivity. We developed the Real-time PCR-based DNA Binding Assay (RP-DBA) to detect and quantify these interactions. The target protein, expressed as a Strep-tag II fusion, is purified and incubated with double-stranded DNA probes containing 4 bp 3’ overhangs. Protein-DNA complexes are immobilized on Strep-Tactin beads, washed, and eluted. A complementary single-stranded DNA amplification arm is added, extended by Taq polymerase, and quantified via qPCR with SYBR Green. RP-DBA enables real-time kinetic analysis and is 4– to 10-fold more sensitive than EMSA, depending on amplification arm length (30–90 bp). Its simplicity, speed, accuracy, and high-throughput potential make it a valuable tool for advancing molecular biology research.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-DNA相互作用对细胞过程至关重要，但现有的定量方法灵敏度不足。我们开发了基于实时PCR的DNA结合实验（RP-DBA），用于检测和定量这些相互作用。目标蛋白以Strep-tag II融合形式表达，经纯化后与含有4 bp 3’突出端的双链DNA探针孵育。蛋白质-DNA复合物固定在Strep-Tactin磁珠上，经洗涤和洗脱。加入互补的单链DNA扩增臂，由Taq聚合酶延伸，并通过SYBR Green进行qPCR定量。RP-DBA能够实现实时动力学分析，其灵敏度比EMSA高4至10倍，具体取决于扩增臂长度（30–90 bp）。其简便性、快速性、准确性和高通量潜力使其成为推进分子生物学研究的宝贵工具。
